prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, low back pain, and associated muscle tension. Examination on initial presentation revealed restricted cervical and lumbar range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and mild radiating discomfort without objective neurological deficit. Imaging was not indicated at the time of initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Over the course of 21 visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and graded activity progression. Pain levels and functional tolerance improved steadily, with reduced muscle guarding and improved lumbar and cervical mobility noted at follow-up assessments. The patient was instructed in a home exercise program and ergonomic modifications for work and daily activities.

At discharge, the patient reported substantial but incomplete resolution of symptoms, with occasional stiffness during prolonged sitting and driving. Neurological screening remained within normal limits throughout care. Continued self-directed exercise and activity modification are recommended, with re-referral should symptoms worsen or new neurological signs develop.
